response.text:
I can’t keep watching the portal or message you later — I don’t have the ability to run background processes or send proactive alerts. 

I can, right now, prepare one of the following so you can shut your laptop:

- Step-by-step to enable vendor-portal/email/mobile notifications (if the portal supports them).  
- A short script (curl + diff) plus instructions to run on a server or cloud VM that will check the report page and notify you.  
- A Zapier/IFTTT recipe to watch the portal/email and notify Slack/SMS/email.  
- A short message you can send to a colleague asking them to watch and notify you immediately.

Tell me: which option you want, the vendor-portal URL (or whether it sends email when the report is posted), and how you want to be notified (SMS, Slack, email). I’ll prepare the exact steps or script now.
